scope: Grouped phone number learning and recall across JSON persistence
findings: 0532 123 45 67 stores and recalls only 0532, losing other groups.
+90 532 123 45 67 and +90 (532) 123 45 67 store no tokens; every fragment falls below recall length.
Numeric groups do not create next-word pairs, so no progressive recovery of subsequent groups.
Six compact/hyphen/dot-separated controls preserve and recall exact surfaces after JSON round trip.
cause: Whitespace tokenizer splits phone numbers; short numeric fragments excluded by isRecallable minimum 4, pairs require isWord.
Context-free token-edge trimming strips initial parenthesis but retains internal closing one.
interpretation: Grouped phone support is a product coverage gap for requested typing convenience; not text corruption during typing. Parenthesis storage loss belongs to already confirmed punctuation family.
limits: Core observe(text:) plus JSON reload and core recall; no live UI or typing test.
Direct core recall prefix may differ from app-normalized prefix; do not claim parenthesis result proves app has no offer.
